description: Health-state utility and event-disutility inputs used to calculate QALYs.
reference: Existing project utility set; values require confirmation against the intended published elicitation studies before final thesis reporting.

state_utilities.description: Utility weights for mutually exclusive model states, where 1 is full health and 0 is death.
state_utilities.reference: Existing model calibration. The repository does not currently document a primary publication for these exact weights; treat them as assumptions until verified.

event_disutilities.description: Temporary decrement applied when bleeding occurs in severe arthropathy, according to the model's event-duration convention.
event_disutilities.reference: Existing project assumption; source and duration interpretation require verification.
